title: Mass Etiquette & Reverence
subtitle: Postures, Quiet, and Preparing Your Mind for Liturgy

sections.content: Entering a Catholic church means entering the presence of the Real Body and Blood of Jesus Christ reserved in the Tabernacle.

items: **Holy Water:** Dip your right hand in the holy water font upon entering and make the Sign of the Cross to recall your baptism.
**Genuflection:** Bend your right knee until it touches the floor towards the Tabernacle before entering your pew.
**Sacred Silence:** Maintain quiet in the nave to allow yourself and others time for mental preparation before Mass begins.
**Standing:** A posture of reverence, resurrection, and active readiness (during opening rites, the Gospel, and Creed).
**Sitting:** A posture of listening, meditation, and instruction (during the First and Second Readings and Homily).
**Kneeling:** A posture of adoration, repentance, and humility before God (during the Eucharistic Prayer and Consecration).

sections.title: Fast Before Mass
sections.content: Catholics abstain from food and drink (except water and medicine) for at least 1 hour prior to receiving Holy Communion.
